A reasonably well-stocked store with helpful staff, but honestly, they should be more cautious about customers' access to dogs, especially large ones, that are walking unleashed. Today, I witnessed a regrettable incident in which a loose German Shepherd, while the owner was at the register paying, attacked an Amstaff that was on a leash and was about to enter. It's a miracle the tragedy didn't happen! Dogs, regardless of size, must be kept on a short leash, not even a long leash, in public places frequented by other dogs, not only for safety reasons but also, and above all, for education and respect. Staff must supervise without any ifs or buts.
